The pictures show the reality of a 21 year old truck that has been used by an active family. Needs an inspection sticker and I’m confident that it’ll pass. I just haven’t set up an appointment because I was planning on getting antique tags. G.E.M is starting to glitch (window switch and radio fuse pops) so electrical needs a look at.
